verdict.rationale: Kling documents native audio co-generation that includes speech, a paid text/image-to-video tier 'with audio + voice control', and persistent character voice via Elements. Together these show generated characters can speak. However, nothing explicitly documents lip movement synchronized to the audio, or speaking the user's own supplied dialogue or audio track. missing for 10: explicit lip-sync documentation, evidence of user-supplied dialogue/audio driving mouth movement, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync quality.

support.subject: As a creator, generated characters speak my dialogue with lip movement matched to the audio
